comment: T4 baseline (docs/TESTING.md). `nodes` counts every node and `retainedNodes` only those carrying a mesh of their own (the Labels). Since P1 all of them draw: `buffersAlive` is 3 whatever the node count, because the frame shares one growing vertex buffer, and `vertices` is what proves every label emitted geometry instead of being dropped by a full pool. `ui.draws` is 20000 and not 253 because the bench alternates a white-texture card with a font-texture label on every node; the unified pipeline and the white texel in the glyph atlas that collapse that are P2's. Counters gate hard; milliseconds only report, with a warn threshold, because this is a shared developer box — SCENE-SCALE.md:197 records its own numbers being taken at load average 14-17. Keys are nested rather than dotted so tests/bench/check.ms can read them through the JsonValue accessors.

taken.renderer: the display list: one growing vertex buffer, one upload, no per-node sg_buffer
